verdict: Baseline established. 23 eval rollouts; 19 succeeded, 4 hit RemoteDisconnected/HTTP 500 from kiln-serve being restarted by an unrelated autonomous loop sharing the pod (pi-compaction-grpo-v062-h12). On the 19 clean rollouts, mean composite = 0.328 ± 0.346; 7 tasks score ~0.71-0.81 (pi-format + content gate passes); 12 tasks score ~0.07 (format gate fail). Bimodal distribution — base model emits pi-format on ~37% of tasks, fails on the rest. Strong gradient signal target for GRPO.

asi.what_worked: End-to-end loop closes: pi-format prompt → kiln chat completion → multi-component rubric. Strong bimodal signal — 7/19 base rollouts pass the gate. The variance across the bimodal distribution gives GRPO clear gradient.
asi.what_failed: Pod-sharing conflict with an unrelated pi-compaction-grpo autonomous loop on the SAME RunPod pod. That loop's bootstrap (process 567) restarted kiln serve mid-eval — 4 tasks hit RemoteDisconnected or HTTP 500. The kiln-pool architecture has no per-tenant isolation; once the pod is leased, anything previously scheduled on it (including other lab bootstraps) can also run.
asi.next_focus: iter 1: H1 default GRPO recipe on 12 shorter training tasks (source_text < 100K chars to keep rollout time bounded). Pre-registered in hypotheses/h1-default-recipe-iter1.md. Falsification threshold: composite uplift >= +0.05 over iter 0 baseline 0.328 on a clean re-eval.
